layers.name: Pages & Routing
layers.description: Next.js App Router route segments, layouts, loading/error states, and server actions for the general dashboard domains (finance, analyse, depot, strategy, inventar, settings) and public-facing pages (landing, login, legal).

layers.name: UI Components
layers.description: Reusable React presentation components (shadcn/ui primitives, layout shell, landing sections, and domain widgets for finance, analyse, strategy, inventar, settings and the dashboard) shared across the app.

layers.name: Core Services & Utilities
layers.description: Cross-cutting business logic, Supabase client helpers, custom hooks, formatting/pagination utilities, shared types, and the edge middleware (proxy.ts) that refreshes Supabase auth tokens.

layers.name: API Routes
layers.description: Generic Next.js Route Handlers and scheduled cron jobs for depot, imports/exports, inventar, and finance automation that are not owned by a dedicated subsystem.

layers.name: Athena AI Assistant

layers.name: Crypto & Kraken Integration
layers.description: Crypto portfolio pages and widgets, Kraken exchange client logic (src/lib/crypto, src/lib/kraken), and the crypto/kraken API routes and sync cron job.

layers.name: Bank Sync (FinTS) Automation
layers.description: FinTS bank-sync subsystem spanning the Python sync scripts (api/bank-sync.py, scripts/fints), src/lib/fints, the bank transaction UI components, and the /api/bank and cron/bank-sync route handlers.

layers.name: Tax Engine & Reports
layers.description: German tax calculation logic (src/lib/tax) and PDF/report generation (src/lib/reports), plus the EUER tax pages, monthly report pages, export route, and the monthly-report cron job.

layers.name: Database Schema & Migrations
layers.description: The Supabase data layer: all 57 SQL migrations, Supabase Edge Functions, project config, and the auto-generated database.ts type definitions.

layers.name: Configuration & Documentation
